response.evidence: In the "On your own server" section, the commands appear as consecutive steps: "Install the project dependencies using your preferred package manager" (npm install), then "Build your Astro site with your preferred package manager" (npm run build), then "Start your application with the following command" (deno run -A jsr:@std/http/file-server dist).
response.rationale: The three commands are presented as successive steps of one deployment procedure on your own server: first install dependencies, then build the site, then start the server serving the built dist output. Each step depends on the previous one (dependencies must exist before building, and the dist output must exist before serving), so they are run in sequence rather than being alternatives. The text never literally states 'in sequence', so this is inferred from the ordered step-by-step list; the npm/pnpm/Yarn tabs only offer variants within each individual step, not between the three commands.
